reason: A proposes a plausible broad-temperature solid-lubricant mechanism and a direct controlled comparison, although it needs a specified h-BN fraction, load, and evidence and must test h-BN oxidation/reactivity near 800 °C. B is less credible because its cited results concern BCC AlCoCrFeNiW coatings rather than FCC CoCrFeNi, and “W0.5” is misrepresented as ~0.5 at.% while the claimed intermetallic formation, severe lattice distortion, oxide glaze, and full-range friction reduction are not supported.
